name: Zweihanders
headerMeta: Golden era · Melee infantry · special · 310 leadership · Seasonal
pitch: A high-damage duelist that cycles in and out of combat every few seconds, getting stronger at max health but vulnerable the moment it breaks formation. Stack it tight and micro its cooldown rotation — it punishes overextension with a quick wipe.

doctrines.name: Zweihander Sword Doctrine
doctrines.note: after Prepared Stance restores health to 100%, next skill +10% slashing damage

doctrines.name: Noble Blood Doctrine
doctrines.note: 100 melee damage taken triggers bleed; +15% damage/move while bleeding

veterancy.label: Top line
veterancy.body: Shorter cooldowns. Designed to deal high damage over extended period; build favors shorter rotations {1}.

battleRole.positioning: Stack tight on formation — the aura persists even after damage, so spawn and activate Prepared Stance immediately, then advance to any engagement. {2} Never lead with it; sit mid-line and cycle in for burst windows.
battleRole.formation: F1 (spread) to avoid overkill and maximize damage across targets. {2} F2 (block) in tight chokepoints where enemy heroes can't flank.
battleRole.tips: Prepared Stance is not a brace — it takes 15% less damage at max health but doesn't stop cavalry. Aura remains visible even after damage and movement. {2} Always rotate with defensive targets: Knight's Gambit first (no burst to soak), then brace, then Knight's Defense to maintain DPS cycle. When flanking isolated enemies, same opener applies — no initial burst, so Knight's Gambit leads. {2}

controls.notes: Prepared Stance (stance, not brace) grants max-health bonus and visible aura at spawn; aura persists through damage and movement. {2} Knight's Defense blocks incoming attacks for two hits (~2 seconds), deals damage while blocking, grants CC immunity; follow with Knight's Gambit without delay or risk crowd control. {2} Knight's Gambit deals big damage, forces overextension; always retreat backwards after. {2} Rotate: when heavy-damage-dealers engage, lead with brace into Knight's Defense then Knight's Gambit; when defensive units are isolated, open with Knight's Gambit. {2} Between engagements, stay in Prepared Stance if safe — small healing window before enemy contact. {2}
